newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: IPCO wins S$110 mln Malaysia water deal.
newsitem.headline: IPCO wins S$110 mln Malaysia water deal.

text.p: Engineering and construction company IPCO International Ltd said on Tuesday its wholly-owned unit IPCO Constructors Sdn Bhd had won a 193 million ringgit (Singapore $110 million) contract to build water supply systems in Sabah, East Malaysia.
IPCO said in a statement the unit won the contract in an international tender.
The project, which involves the supply of 72 million litres per day of water, is expected to take 42 months to complete.
"The...project is expected to contribute to the turnover and profit of the group for the financial year ending June 30, 1997," it said.
